data.title: Obfuscated Payload Storage
data.summary: Secondary payloads, configuration, or support files the sample depends on are stored encoded or encrypted on disk, separate from the packing applied to the main executable itself.
data.description:
This covers dropped artefacts beyond the primary binary — an encrypted configuration blob,
a second-stage payload stored as an encoded resource, a script stored base64-and-XOR'd in a
registry value or file. The decoding routine is usually small and reused verbatim across a
family's samples, which makes it a reliable way to recover related artefacts once
identified once.
data.recommendation:
* Locate the decoding routine and run it standalone against every suspected encoded artefact, not only the one it was first found decoding.
* Search for the same decode routine (or a near-identical one) across other samples and artefacts suspected to belong to the same family.
* Recover and analyse the decoded content before scoring the sample — the encoded form alone understates its real capability.
data.short_recommendation: Locate the decode routine and run it against every suspected encoded artefact, not only the first one found.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Stored its configuration as a base64-and-XOR-encoded resource, decoded by a small routine at module start.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Configuration blob was encrypted on disk and decrypted into memory immediately before use.
